changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE couriers ( courier_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, last_latitude DOUBLE PRECISION, last_longitude DOUBLE PRECISION, last_processed_time TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE, total_distance_meters DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, current_store_name TEXT, last_store_name TEXT, last_store_entry_time TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE, last_report_entered BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false, created_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT ck_courier_travel_state CHECK ( (last_processed_time IS NULL AND last_latitude IS NULL AND last_longitude IS NULL AND total_distance_meters = 0) OR (last_processed_time IS NOT NULL AND last_latitude IS NOT NULL AND last_longitude IS NOT NULL) ), CONSTRAINT ck_courier_total_distance CHECK ( total_distance_meters >= 0 AND total_distance_meters < 'Infinity'::DOUBLE PRECISION ), CONSTRAINT ck_courier_store_summary CHECK ( (last_store_name IS NULL AND last_store_entry_time IS NULL AND current_store_name IS NULL) OR (last_store_name IS NOT NULL AND last_store_entry_time IS NOT NULL) ) );

changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE courier_location_inputs ( id BIGINT GENERATED BY DEFAULT AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY, input_time TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, courier_id TEXT NOT NULL, latitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, longitude DOUBLE PRECISION NOT NULL, created_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at TIMESTAMP(3) WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), CONSTRAINT uq_courier_location_input UNIQUE (courier_id, input_time, latitude, longitude) );
